zh-Hans: 成员身份

en: Join club
zh-Hans: 加入俱乐部

en: Apply to join
zh-Hans: 申请加入

en: Apply again
zh-Hans: 重新申请

en: Leave club
zh-Hans: 退出俱乐部

en: Send a request to join this club. Your membership will be checked with the server.
zh-Hans: 向此俱乐部发送加入请求，随后从服务器确认成员状态。

en: Send an application to this club. You will become a member only after approval.
zh-Hans: 向此俱乐部发送申请，审批通过后才能成为成员。

en: Leave this club? You may lose access to its members and member-only features. Rejoining may require approval.
zh-Hans: 确定退出此俱乐部？你可能无法再查看成员及使用成员专属功能，重新加入可能需要审批。

en: Membership actions are not configured.
zh-Hans: 成员操作尚未配置。

en: Creators cannot leave their own club here.
zh-Hans: 创建者不能在此退出自己的俱乐部。

en: Joining is unavailable for a merchant account.
zh-Hans: 商家账号无法在此加入俱乐部。

en: This membership state is not supported. Refresh to check the current status.
zh-Hans: 暂不支持此成员状态，请刷新查看最新状态。

en: Checking membership…
zh-Hans: 正在确认成员状态…

en: The request may have reached the server. It will not be sent again. You can check your current membership below.
zh-Hans: 请求可能已到达服务器，不会再次发送。你可以在下方查看当前成员状态。

en: Check current membership
zh-Hans: 查看当前成员状态

en: The server acknowledged the request. Current membership is shown below when available.
zh-Hans: 服务器已确认收到请求；获取成功后，下方会显示当前成员状态。

en: No membership request was sent. Refresh the club before trying again.
zh-Hans: 尚未发送成员请求，请刷新俱乐部后再试。

en: The server declined the request.
zh-Hans: 服务器拒绝了此请求。

en: Current status: not a member
zh-Hans: 当前状态：非成员

en: Current membership could not be checked. Check again before taking another action.
zh-Hans: 当前无法确认成员状态，请再次查询后再操作。

en: Membership or joining policy changed. Refresh the club and review the new action.
zh-Hans: 成员状态或加入规则已改变，请刷新俱乐部并确认最新操作。

en: Could not check current membership. No request was sent.
zh-Hans: 无法确认当前成员状态，尚未发送请求。

en: Offline membership fixture · no real club changes
zh-Hans: 离线成员示例 · 不会更改真实俱乐部

en: Synthetic requests:
zh-Hans: 模拟请求数：
